reviews.title: Misleading and missing service information.
reviews.text:
Full major service 4 months ago not recorded and a scrape to a front wing turned into damaged door and front bumper as well, which was not the case.  I suggest that they review their information sources.
Will not use again.

reviews.title: Istorie mașina
reviews.text: Am verificat o mașină și aici pe carVertical arată tot verde tot bună fără accidente fără nimic și la urmă când eu am fost să verific mașina era mai mult de jumate de mașină pălită și vopsită ,nu recomand

reviews.title: Expensive and unhelpful
reviews.text: Have tried this app on a couple of occasions now and each time have been disappointed with the results. Either being provided incorrect information, paying for information thats free on other basic checkers or simply not being able to find vehicle details based on vin plates or reg. its pushed by automotive YouTubers as the holy grail of car checkers but it falls a long way short. Also be warned, if you purchase multiple reports, they expire after around 6 months.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Would leave 0 star if I could. Used my own number plate to check my car’s history, before you use a credit it shows as a bmw m5 correctly. Soon as you use a credit it says the car is a bmw 330d, what an absolute rip off

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
The data provided is incorrect and they don’t want to know. 
I struggled to sell a car because dealers using car vertical kept telling me the car was written off. After a phone call to DVLA and a full HPI report this was in fact incorrect due to a private number plate previously assigned to the vehicle was written off on a separate vehicle. 
Also I purchased a car which car vertical stated had 2 previous owners. 
When the V5 turned up it had 7. Again they are not interested. Save the hassle and do a full HPI report. 
You have been warned.

reviews.title: Not as it seems
reviews.text:
I submitted a report for a car I wanted to purchase. It showed no issues on carVertical. Once I purchased the vehicle I was made aware afterwards it’s been in an accident. I ran another report on another car history website and it showed the car has been in 3 accidents! 

I am very disappointed in this app and I will no longer be using this app to help me when purchasing or doing background checks on vehicles.

reviews.title: GREED
reviews.text: 35$ to check a report on 1 car. 70$ for 2 and 104$ for 3.

reviews.title: Not a great service
reviews.text: If you don’t use your check in an allocated time they expire! The check do use only last 28 days after that you can’t see them or download them. Much better apps out there which do exactly that for less.

reviews.title: Go Elsewhere
reviews.text: No recourse for incomplete or useless data otherwise available from loads of online sources, slow useless customer service with excuses for not refunding you when they can’t get you what you need. Don’t waste your wages here people.
